A4_economic_interpretation.original_primary_target: forward_excess_beta over 60 calendar days, defined as stock_forward_return minus beta_pre * SPY_forward_return, not realized portfolio profit
A4_economic_interpretation.original_candidate_absolute_means: Negative in all original V2 V3 V4 reported results; a positive candidate-minus-baseline does not establish cash outperformance.
A4_economic_interpretation.cash_flat_arm: zero exposure and zero nominal gross return under explicit zero-interest-cash simplification; subtracting zero from an excess-beta score is invalid because estimands differ.
A4_economic_interpretation.no_action_policy: Flat comparison is economically meaningful only versus a separately calculated and labeled absolute gross stock-return or implementable capital-return metric.
A4_economic_interpretation.nonfinancial_revision_action: Explain counterfactual abstention, risk exposure, negative absolute excess-beta, costs, beta-market exposures, horizon overlap and no actual trading record.

conditional_secondary_old_data_analysis.allowed_if: Original price, event-time alignment, corporate-action effects, overlap-aware portfolio mapping, shared capital denominators, and full source SHA/coverage gates explicitly frozen before opening financial values.
fixed_optional_metrics: event-level historical absolute gross stock return per admitted selection
gross stock return downside q0.05 and q0.10
historical fraction of negative simple returns
mean and median hypothetical gross absolute returns
hypothetical flat gross return zero under explicitly zero-yield cash assumption
conditional_secondary_old_data_analysis.costs: Only fixed transparent scenario assumptions, e.g. gross and predeclared one-way roundtrip fee/slippage grid, IF source/capital execution protocol is feasible. No ex post selected cost point.
conditional_secondary_old_data_analysis.turnover: Requires ex ante defined repeated-ticker position netting, event overlap, entry/exit, dollar weights; otherwise NOT_ESTIMABLE_AS_PORTFOLIO_TURNOVER.
conditional_secondary_old_data_analysis.signal_level_vs_portfolio: Event-level hypothetical return rows are not a self-financing portfolio performance claim and overlapping 60-day windows forbid simply summing event profits.
conditional_secondary_old_data_analysis.hard_stop: If unavailable execution times/price adjustments/capital accounting prevent an authentic portfolio replay, publish descriptive data with NOT_ESTIMABLE for P&L/turnover/cost savings. Do not invent trading.

A6_capacity_sensitivity.original_frozen_K_rule: floor(N*0.10) in original V2/V3/V4, fixed same K in both arms
A6_capacity_sensitivity.meaning: A matched experimental coverage/selection budget, not empirically measured capital or liquidity capacity.
A6_capacity_sensitivity.estimand: Change in candidate minus original baseline mean forward_excess_beta on same original cohort under each predeclared K; not strategy P&L.
A6_capacity_sensitivity.ranking: Original same ex-ante ranker iteration 10 and canonical ordering/ties, same P10 calibration and frozen q25 veto; no alternate calibration or ranking
A6_capacity_sensitivity.K_formula: floor(frac * original number of cohort pairs) per frac and cohort, same baseline and candidate full K, no rounding to a favorable K
A6_capacity_sensitivity.candidate: Original absolute P10 mask not substituted; original frozen relative q25 veto only.
report_all_9_cells: news/ticker cluster bootstrap CI if predeclared feasible
A6_capacity_sensitivity.infeasible: INFEASIBLE, no partial-K synthetic fill and no favorable cell selection
A6_capacity_sensitivity.bootstrap: Original news-id and ticker 10,000 resamples, seeds 20260821 and 20260822, 95% percentile intervals with full-K capacity recomputed
A6_capacity_sensitivity.overlap_and_multiplicity: Three historic outcome-consumed cohorts; no pooled independence p-value, no optimized K selection.
